obernants.assumptions: Source-derived branch/ABI relations require valid host resources and finite guest input. is_wasi_name only checks namespace/name, not type. Metadata rights differ from cached file access flags. Example compiles but is not executed; mlab source is external reference only. No useful percentage surrogate established.
obernants.domain: CPU; nine memory/engine tests, two synthetic integration tests; memory<=8192 bytes and minimal empty/unreachable wasm; filesystem effects restricted to unique own temporary roots. No full mlab.wasm, frozen suites, large guest build, live data or network.
obernants.observation_scope: Real join: Ctx::path_open resolves through Vfs, allocates descriptor; fd_write/read use canonical stored path and Vfs::write_at/read_at, with Vfs errno and journal propagation. Tests observe holes/append/read-only/limits/escape effects. main constructs Ctx from imported Vfs, Host::run returns same context for gated exports. Tagged independent paths: example mlab_gate and tests/mlab compare external mlab::Interp to Host, neither is called by main. Memory-unit tests bypass add_wasi ABI wrappers; tiny guests have no imports, so complete linker wiring is not claimed.
obernants.operator: For successful CLI parsing and completed Host run, trap/nonzero outcome excludes export execution through main's gate; memory-gated socket helpers exclude network effects. Late FAULT does not exclude earlier Vfs changes. These are scoped source-derived exclusion relations, not whole-sandbox proofs.

Capture, truncation, overwritten guest memory and Vfs mutations lose histories; equal output is not unique reconstruction and exit0 merges normal return with proc_exit(0). Journal, argv and original state can narrow but not generally invert the relation.

obernants.operator: Relative UTF8 path + directory fd -> canonical Vfs path -> descriptor carrying path/offset/flags -> iovec bytes -> Vfs read_at/write_at -> copied output/count. Explicit positioned writes override append and preserve fd position; implicit append uses file size. Finite direct-helper fixtures exercise this actual caller join.
